content: Makeḍoniyat edde Girik dešot sofor
Gulmal tamizaigoi bade Paulose biššaši okkolore ḍakito defeṛaiye. Tarfore hitarare tuwajjo diye edde hitarattu bidai loi hiba Makeḍoniyar mikka baisa diye.
Makeḍoniya bai zaibar šomot Paulose bout hota okkol hoi manuš okkolore tuwajjo diye. Bade hiba Girik dešot aišše,
zeṛe hiba tin maš taikke. Tarfore hibaye hentu zahazot gori Siriya dešot zaito sar funi Ihudi okkole hibar berudde sail solaye, hetolla hibaye ṭik goijjil ze hiba Makeḍoniya bai uwafes firizaibogoi.
Modot goroya hisabe Beriya šohorottu Firosor fuwa Sopatros, Tessalonikattu Aristarkos edde Sekundus, Dorbittu Gaius, Timoti, edde Ešiyattu Tikiyos edde Trofimos hibar fũwati aššil.
Ei manuš okkole age Troas šohorot zai ãralla entezar goijjil.
Iš adiya ruṭir id bade ãra doriyar fõte Filifittu baisa šuru gorilam, ar fãs din bade Troasot hitarar loi dola oilam edde heṛe ãra hãt din takilam.
Utukore zibon diye
Haftar foila din ãra ekkui fũwati Isar ruṭi bangibolla dola oilam. Hẽtte Paulose hitara loi hota hoiye. Tarforor din hitara zaibar hota aššil buli Paulose ada raitta foijjonto hota howat aššil.
Ãra uworor ṭalat ze górot dola oilam heṛe bout beši serag okkol aššil.

Utuk name ekzon zuwan fuwaye he góror kirkirir uwore boi aššil. Paulose bout hotun dori hota hoil boli hite aste aste gumot fori gilgoi. Gum bári oiyede šomot hite tin ṭalar uwottu lamat fori giyegoi, hitare tuli loiyede šomot hite mora.
Hetunot Paulose nise lami giye edde he fuwawar uwore niyuriyore hitare sibi doijje edde hodde: "Tũwara no ḍoraiyo, hite basi ase!"
Tarfore Paulose abar uworor ṭalat zai Isar ruṭi bangi háiye edde raitta loti binna ofan foijjonto hota hoiye edde hiba henttu giyegoi.
Zuwan fuwaware hitara zinda górot loigiye edde beši šantona faiye.
Efisusor murubbi okkol loi bidair hota
Ãra agottu zai zahazot uṛi Assosor mikka baisa dilam, zentu Paulosore tuli loibar hota aššil. Hibare tuli loibolla ãra loi age hota ṭik aššil, kiyollahoile hiba aṛar fõte heṛe zat aššil.
Assosot ãrar loi hibaye deha oiye, bade ãra hibare zahazot tuli loilam edde Mitulanit ailam.
Tarfor din ãra hentu baisa di Kios ḍiyar ḍakaḍaikka fõsilam. Tarforor din ãra doriya farai Samos ḍiyat gilam. Iyar bado din ãra Miletusot fõsilam.
Ešiyat zene deri no o hiyanolla Paulose faisela loiye ze hiba Efisusot no oziyore zaiboi. Hibaye Zeruzalem fõsibolla zolti goijjil, zene šombob oile fõnzaš dinna idor dinot hiba heṛe hazir oi fare.
Paulose Miletusottu Efisusot manuš defeṛaiye heṛiyar zomator murubbi okkolore ḍakibolla.
Hitara heṛe zehon aišše Paulose hitarare hodde: "Ešia dešot ai bade foila din loti šob šome ãi tũwarar fũwati kene ṭaim haṛaiyi tũwara zano.
Ihudi okkolor bout ḍoilla dukor duwara ãttu entehanot fora foijje, tarfore o ãi kub šorol mone edde sukor fani loi Malikor šeba gorat roiyi.
Tũwarar modot ode hendilla hono kissu tũwarare no hoi ãi nizam no taki, bolke barkule kulasa bafe edde tũwarar góre góre šikka diyi edde tobolig goijji.
Ãi Ihudi edde Girik okkolor hãse goba diyi gunattu mon firai Allar mikka hitarattu fira foribo. Ar ãrar Malik Isar uwore biššaš ana foribo.
Ar so, ehon ãi Pak Ruhur hokume Zeruzalem zair. Heṛe ãr uwore ki goṭibo hin ãi no zani.
Ãi šude iyan zani, Pak Ruhuye fotti šohorot ãre ei hota zanaiye ze ãttu ziyol haṛa edde hošto fa foribo.
Kintu ãr foranor hono foruwa no gori, zodi ãi ei dũra šeš gori fari, mani Isaye ze hamor bar ãre diye hiyan šeš gori fari. He ham oilde Allar rahamotor kušir hóboror babute goba diya.
"Ehon ãi ei hota zani ze eto din tũwara zarar hãse ãi Allar raijjor babute tobolig goijji, hitarar honokiye ãre ar no dekiba.
Hetolla aijja, ãi tũwarare foriškar gori hoir, hono kiyor louwor daiyottu ãi halas.
Kiyollahoile Allah ki sar hiyan tũwarare zanaite ãi hono din fis fa no gori.
Tũwara nize edde he fura zakor babute hũšiyar taikko, ze zakor uwore Pak Ruhuye tũwarare dehafuna goroya goijje. Allar zomator soolsoroya o, ze zomatore hibaye hibar nizor lou diyore zitte.
Ãi zani ãi zailegoi bade bukalo genḍa bag okkol tũwarar butore aibo edde soolor zakor hoti goribo.
Enki, tũwarar nizor butottu manuš okkol uṛi Allar soyire misa banaibolla kušiš goribo, zene biššaši okkolore nizor dolor mikka ṭani loizai fare.
Etolla tũwara seton taikko. Monot raikko, tin bosor dori dine raite sukor fani loi ãi tũwara fottikiyore hũšiyar goijjilam, hono din suf gori no taki.
"Ar ehon ãi tũwarare Allah edde hibar rahamotor kalamor hãse šebi dilam, zine tũwarare gori tulibo edde Allar Paki bonda okkolor fũwati tũwarare miraz dibo.
Honokiyor šuna, rufa, otóba hor suworor uwore ãi lalsi no gori.
Tũwara nize zanode hota ze ãr ei dui hate ãr edde ar fũwajja okkolor obaf miṭaiye.
Ãi zin goijji hin hár kissu tũwarare dehaiyi, ze endilla dukkor mehennot goriyore ošohai okkolore modot gora dorhar. Ar ãrar Malik Isar ei hota ãrattu monot raka dorhar ze,

content.text: 'Fattuwaro diyat maze aro beši rahamot ase.'

content: Ei hota hoi bade Paulos beggunor fũwati ãṛu felai munazat goijje.
Bade beggune Paulosore gola sai berai dori hainde edde hibare suma diye.
Paulosor muk hitara ar no dekibo, has gori ei hotagan loi hitara beši šuk goijje. Bade hitara hibar fũwati fũwati zahazor heṛe foijjonto giye.
